WITH RankedSecurities AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM reference.scd_securities
    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-25'
)

select a.*, b.*
from 
    (select 							
        '2025-06-25' as business_date,
        cast(h.scd_holding_key_id as varchar) AS id_source_holding,
        NULL AS id_enterprise_holding,
        h.model_portfolio_id AS id_model_portfolio,			
        sec.abor_issue_currency AS currency,	
        h.abor_security_number AS security_no,	
        h.abor_security_name AS security_name,
        h.abor_security_type_id AS security_type_code,		
        h.abor_security_type_name AS security_type_name,	
        h.security_group_id AS security_group_code,		
        h.security_group_name AS security_group_name,
        sec.abor_coupon_term_length AS coupon_term_length,
        sec.abor_coupon_term_unit AS coupon_term_unit,
        cast(h.balance_book_value_quotation_currency as DECIMAL(18,2)) as balance_book_value_qc,
        cast(h.balance_book_value_portfolio_currency as DECIMAL(18,2)) as balance_book_value_pc,
        cast(h.abor_maturity_date as TIMESTAMP) AS maturity_date,
        sec.abor_interest_type AS coupon_payment_type_name,
        cast(h.clean_price as DECIMAL(18,2)) as clean_price_qc,
        h.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency * h.clean_price AS clean_price_pc,
        h.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS clean_value_pc, 
        h.abor_instrument_type AS instrument_type_name,
        sec.abor_coupon_rate AS coupon_rate,
        h.clean_value_quotation_currency AS clean_value_qc,
        sec.abor_country_id AS country_code,
        par.party_name AS issuer_name,
        sec.country_of_exposure_code AS exposure_country_code,
        sec.currency_of_exposure_code AS exposure_currency_code,
        sec.country_of_exposure_name AS exposure_country_name,
        sec.currency_of_exposure_name AS exposure_currency_name,
        h.abor_security_id AS security_id										
	from RankedSecurities sec
	left join reference.scd_party_issuer par
		on sec.abor_issuer_id = par.party_id and sec.business_date = par.business_date
	join holdings.scd_holdings_main h
		on h.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
	where sec.rn = 1
	   and h.business_date = '2025-06-25'					
    ) as a							
join							
    (select
     id_instrument_alternate,
     id_instrument,
     id_instrument as id_instrument_pos,
     id_underlying_instrument_pos,
     carrying_value_base_cur ,
     carrying_value_local_cur,
     equity_carrying_value_local_cur,
     equity_carrying_value_base_cur,
     debt_carrying_value_local_cur,
     debt_carrying_value_base_cur,
     currency_of_exposure as currency_of_exposure_source,
     investment_type_al,
     asset_count,
     sector_focus_level_1_al,
     sector_focus_level_2_al,
     investment_manager_al,
     investment_stage_current_al,
     underlying_asset_name,
     investment_instrument_id_type as instrument_id_type
     from alternative_assets.yardi_holdings
     where  business_date = (select max(business_date) from alternative_assets.yardi_holdings
      where business_date <= date'2025-06-25')
     ) as b
     on a.id_model_portfolio = b.id_instrument_alternate
where
    a.instrument_type_name = 'Index certificate' and
    a.security_type_name like 'Real Estate%' and 
    (a.clean_value_pc != 0 or a.clean_price_pc != 0) and
    ((a.security_group_code = 'RE UNDER' and a.security_type_code = 'RE UNDER') or
	 (a.security_group_code = 'REFUND' and a.security_type_code IN ('REFD', 'RE MTGE FD')) or
	 (a.security_group_code = 'REDIRECT' and a.security_type_code IN ('REJV', 'RE MTGE JV')))

select 
exposure_currency, investment_program, business_date, SUM(final_value + future_cash_flows_cad) final_exposure_currency_amount
from
(
SELECT business_date, position_key, data_source, exposure_currency, exposure_currency_amount, final_value, override_source, override_value, portfolio_type, local_currency, source_system_notional_local_ccy, source_system_pv_local_ccy, position_description, model_portfolio, 
investment_dept, investment_strategy, investment_program, investment_sub_program, product_type, product_group,

case WHEN override_source = 'OFFSET' then -1 else 1 end * coalesce(fcp.future_cash_flows_local,0) future_cash_flows_local,
case WHEN override_source = 'OFFSET' then -1 else 1 end * coalesce(fcp.future_cash_flows_cad,0) future_cash_flows_cad
FROM risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure 
left join
(SELECT
trade_id,
future_cashflows_currency,
SUM( future_cash_flows ) future_cash_flows_local,
SUM( future_cash_flows * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad ) future_cash_flows_cad
FROM df_trusted_prod.murex_total_return_swap_trade_latest 
where business_date = date '2025-06-24' 
group by trade_id, future_cashflows_currency ) fcp ON 

CASE 
WHEN risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.position_key LIKE 'MX%' THEN SUBSTRING(risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.position_key FROM 3)
ELSE risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.position_key
END = fcp.trade_id and risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.exposure_currency = fcp.future_cashflows_currency

WHERE 
risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.business_date IN ( '2025-06-24' ) and
risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.investment_dept = 'Active Equities' and 
risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.investment_strategy in ( 'LatAm') and 
risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.investment_program in ( 'Latin America Public Investments')


) risk_database
group by exposure_currency, investment_program, business_date

    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
						order by
							changed_date desc -- change date is actual loaded date so use this to get the latest data.
           ) AS rn
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    WHERE accounting_framework_id = 'PCLFWKMAIN'
),
JoinedData AS (
    SELECT 
        st.scd_transaction_number_primary_key,
        CAST(st.business_date AS DATE) AS business_date,
        ROUND(st.abor_transaction_number) AS abor_transaction_number,
        st.abor_security_id,
        st.abor_security_number,
        st.abor_security_name,
        st.model_portfolio_id,

        st.business_transaction_code,

        CAST(st.payment_date AS DATE) AS payment_date,
        st.nominal,
        st.nominal_basis,
        st.elementary_transaction_code,
        st.interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency,
        st.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,
        st.transaction_cancellation_flag,
        st.reconciliation_status,
        CAST(CAST(st.created_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS created_date,
        st.transaction_number_in_originating_system,
        st.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,

        st.settlement_location,
        st.quotation_currency,
        st.number_of_units,
        st.price AS price_qc,
        st.price * st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS price_pc,
        st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,

        st.current_value_portfolio_currency,
        st.current_value_quotation_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_portfolio_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.ibor_reason,
        st.dividend_per_share,
        st.borrowing_account,
        st.rn,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') AND st.abor_security_name LIKE '%CAD%' THEN 'Y'
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') THEN 'N'
        END AS cross_deal_indicator,
        -- From joins
        es.sedol,
        es.isin,
        es.cusip,
        es.esm_incorp_country_code,
        es.security_name_id,
        es.esm_country_code,
        es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
        es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,

        ep.party_id,
        ep.epm_party_name,
        ss.abor_security_group_name,
        ss.abor_security_type_name,
        ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
        ss.investment_type_name,
        ss.abor_coupon_rate,
        rec.country_ref_code,
        rcc_exchange_country.country_name AS esm_country_name,

        sp.portfolio_group_id,
        sp.portfolio_name,

        FROM asset.enterprise_security
    ) es ON st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id AND es.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
        ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)
        AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id

        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd_party_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn

    	where exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'

        ON es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
        AND coalesce(es.mic, 'null') = coalesce(rec.mic, 'null')
        AND rec.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country 
        ON es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country 
        ON es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
        AND rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)

        FROM reference.scd_portfolio

				transaction_cancellation_flag,

		 	GROUP BY abor_transaction_number,
		    	business_date,
		    	transaction_cancellation_flag,
		    	trade_date
		    )

        ON stc.latest = 1
        AND stc.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
        AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
        AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
        AND st.cost_or_tax_present = 'Yes'
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc 
        ON st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
        AND rcc.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_currency_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model_portfolio ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    ) spif
        ON spif.model_portfolio = st.model_portfolio_id
        AND spif.rn = 1
)
SELECT *
FROM JoinedData
WHERE rn = 1
AND transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active') AS "transactions_base"

    	select distinct exchange_name, mic, business_date, country_ref_code
    	from reference.reference_exchange_codes
    	where exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
    ) rec 
        ON es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
        AND coalesce(es.mic, 'null') = coalesce(rec.mic, 'null')
        AND rec.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country 
        ON es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country 
        ON es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
        AND rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS latest
        FROM reference.scd_portfolio
    ) sp ON sp.latest = 1 AND sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country 
        ON rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
        AND rcc_trade_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT *,
		    ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY abor_transaction_number ORDER BY business_date DESC ) AS latest
		FROM (
			SELECT abor_transaction_number,
				business_date,
				transaction_cancellation_flag,
				trade_date,
				MAX(abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency) abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Cost' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
				MAX(abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency) abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Cost' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) restitution_expected_settlement_currency
		 	FROM trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
		 	GROUP BY abor_transaction_number,
		    	business_date,
		    	transaction_cancellation_flag,
		    	trade_date
		    )
    ) stc
        ON stc.latest = 1
        AND stc.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
        AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
        AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
        AND st.cost_or_tax_present = 'Yes'
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc 
        ON st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
        AND rcc.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_currency_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model_portfolio ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    ) spif
        ON spif.model_portfolio = st.model_portfolio_id
        AND spif.rn = 1
)
SELECT *
FROM JoinedData
WHERE rn = 1
AND transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active') AS "transactions_base"

        cast(coalesce(CASE WHEN T_1_CLEAN_PRC_UC IS NULL AND T_2_CLEAN_PRC_UC IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(T_1_CLEAN_PRC_UC,0) - coalesce(T_2_CLEAN_PRC_UC,0)) END, 0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS CLEAN_PRC_UC_VARIANCE ,
        cast(coalesce(CASE WHEN T_1_FX_RTE_QC_PC IS NULL AND T_2_FX_RTE_QC_PC IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(T_1_FX_RTE_QC_PC,0) - coalesce(T_2_FX_RTE_QC_PC,0)) END, 0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS FX_RTE_QC_PC_VARIANCE ,
        cast(coalesce(CASE WHEN T_1_FX_RTE_UC_QC IS NULL AND T_2_FX_RTE_UC_QC IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(T_1_FX_RTE_UC_QC,0) - coalesce(T_2_FX_RTE_UC_QC,0)) END, 0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS FX_RTE_UC_QC_VARIANCE 
        FROM (          
              SELECT MAX(bus_dte) BUS_DTE,              
                     mpfc1_cde,
                     mpfc2_cde,
                     mport_cde,
                     instr_typ_nme,
                     sec_typ_nme,
                     sec_no,
                     sec_nme,
                     id_cppibsec,

                     id_isin, 
                     id_cusip,

                     holding_level,
                     src_system_nme,
                     quoted_crncy,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN xyz.balance_nominal ELSE 0 END) T_1_BAL_NOMINAL,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN xyz.balance_nominal ELSE 0 END) T_2_BAL_NOMINAL,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN xyz.total_market_value_pc ELSE 0 END) T_1_LT_MKTVAL,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN xyz.total_market_value_pc ELSE 0 END) T_2_LT_MKTVAL,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN (xyz.total_market_value_qc/xyz.balance_nominal) ELSE 0 END) T_1_CLEAN_PRC_QC,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN (xyz.total_market_value_qc/xyz.balance_nominal)  ELSE 0 END) T_2_CLEAN_PRC_QC,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN (xyz.total_market_value_qc/xyz.balance_nominal)* (1/FXRATE_UC_QC) ELSE 0 END) T_1_CLEAN_PRC_UC,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN (xyz.total_market_value_qc/xyz.balance_nominal)* (1/FXRATE_UC_QC) ELSE 0 END) T_2_CLEAN_PRC_UC ,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN xyz.FXRATE_QC_PC ELSE 0 END) T_1_FX_RTE_QC_PC,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN xyz.FXRATE_QC_PC ELSE 0 END) T_2_FX_RTE_QC_PC,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN xyz.FXRATE_UC_QC ELSE 0 END) T_1_FX_RTE_UC_QC,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN xyz.FXRATE_UC_QC ELSE 0 END) T_2_FX_RTE_UC_QC                    
				from	
					(SELECT mhl.business_date as bus_dte,

                     mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code as quoted_crncy,
                     CASE WHEN mhl.balance_nominal = 0 THEN NULL ELSE mhl.balance_nominal END as balance_nominal,                     
                     mhl.total_market_value_pc,                     
                     mhl.total_market_value_qc,
					 Round(CASE WHEN mhl.underlying_currency_code = mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code THEN 1.00 
								WHEN FXRATE_Quoted.inv_quoted_flg=1 AND FXRATE_Underlying.inv_quoted_flg=0 THEN (FXRATE_Underlying.MID_VAL * FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL) 
								WHEN FXRATE_Quoted.inv_quoted_flg=0 AND FXRATE_Underlying.inv_quoted_flg=1 THEN 1/(FXRATE_Underlying.MID_VAL * FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL) 
								WHEN FXRATE_Quoted.inv_quoted_flg=1 AND FXRATE_Underlying.inv_quoted_flg=1 THEN (FXRATE_Underlying.MID_VAL / FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL) 
								ELSE (FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL / FXRATE_Underlying.MID_VAL  )
							END,8) as FXRATE_UC_QC, 
					 Round(CASE  WHEN 'CAD' = mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code THEN 1.00 
								WHEN FXRATE_Quoted.inv_quoted_flg=1 AND FXRATE_Portfolio.inv_quoted_flg=0 THEN (FXRATE_Portfolio.MID_VAL * FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL ) 
								WHEN FXRATE_Quoted.inv_quoted_flg=0 AND FXRATE_Portfolio.inv_quoted_flg=1 THEN 1/ (FXRATE_Portfolio.MID_VAL * FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL  ) 
								WHEN FXRATE_Quoted.inv_quoted_flg=1 AND FXRATE_Portfolio.inv_quoted_flg=1 THEN (FXRATE_Portfolio.MID_VAL / FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL  ) 
								ELSE (FXRATE_Portfolio.MID_VAL / FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL )
							END,8) as FXRATE_QC_PC,
                     T1_T2_Dates.T_1_Date,
                     T1_T2_Dates.T_2_Date					 
					from holdings.enterprise_holding eh
                    join holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough_extended mhl on  mhl.business_Date  = eh.business_Date and eh.scd_holding_key_id = cast(mhl.parent_holding_key as varchar)
					join T1_T2_Dates T1_T2_Dates ON eh.business_date  = T1_T2_Dates.T_1_Date OR eh.business_date = T1_T2_Dates.T_2_Date
                    LEFT JOIN asset.enterprise_security escundl ON mhl.enterprise_security_id = escundl.enterprise_security_id and mhl.business_date = escundl.business_date --child
					left outer join FXRATE FXRATE_Quoted ON  FXRATE_Quoted.TO_CRNCY =  mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code and FXRATE_Quoted.business_date = mhl.business_date
				    left outer join FXRATE FXRATE_Underlying ON  FXRATE_Underlying.TO_CRNCY =  mhl.underlying_currency_code and FXRATE_Underlying.business_date = mhl.business_date   
                    left outer join FXRATE FXRATE_Portfolio ON  FXRATE_Portfolio.TO_CRNCY =  'CAD'  and FXRATE_Portfolio.business_date = mhl.business_date  
                    WHERE 1=1
                 and eh.portfolio_calculation_id = 'RISK METRICS_DAILY'
                and eh.portfolio_group_id = 'CPPIB GROUP'
                     AND ( 
							(upper(trim(eh.abor_security_type_id)) in ('FUT_BOND','CDS','TRSEQIC','TRSFIIC')    
								AND upper(mhl.holding_level) = 'LOOK THROUGH')
							OR
							((upper(trim(eh.abor_security_type_id))) in ('OP_OC_CR','IRS_IR','OP_OC_SW_P','OP_OC_SW_W')
								and upper(mhl.holding_level) = 'TOP LEVEL')
						) 
                    AND ( (  upper(trim(mhl.parent_security_type_name)) not LIKE '%INDEX%' 
                                  and mhl.leg_no < 2 
                                  AND upper(trim(eh.abor_security_type_id)) in ('FUT_BOND','TRSEQIC','TRSFIIC'))
                        OR ( mhl.leg_no = 2 AND upper(trim(eh.abor_security_type_id)) = 'CDS') )
					) xyz
                    GROUP BY 
					 mpfc1_cde,
                     mpfc2_cde,
                     mport_cde,
                     instr_typ_nme,
                     sec_typ_nme,
                     sec_no,
                     sec_nme,
                     id_cppibsec,
                     id_bb_ticker,
                     id_isin, 
                     id_cusip, 
                     ID_BB_COMPANY,
                     leg_no,
                     holding_level,
                     src_system_nme,
                     quoted_crncy
            )              
        WHERE
        1 = 1
        AND 
        (
          (T_1_BAL_NOMINAL IS NOT NULL OR T_2_BAL_NOMINAL IS NOT NULL) OR          
          (T_1_LT_MKTVAL IS NOT NULL OR T_2_LT_MKTVAL IS NOT NULL) OR
          (T_1_CLEAN_PRC_QC IS NOT NULL OR T_2_CLEAN_PRC_QC IS NOT NULL) OR
          (T_1_CLEAN_PRC_UC IS NOT NULL OR T_2_CLEAN_PRC_UC IS NOT NULL) OR
		  (T_1_FX_RTE_QC_PC IS NOT NULL OR T_2_FX_RTE_QC_PC IS NOT NULL) OR
          (T_1_FX_RTE_UC_QC IS NOT NULL OR T_2_FX_RTE_UC_QC IS NOT NULL))

WITH 
TENDAYS as
(select cast(t.date as date) as business_date
from (select sequence(current_date - interval '10' day, current_date, interval '1' day) dates),
     unnest(dates) as t(date)
 ),
FXRATE AS
    (select distinct * from
	    (select distinct mcr.business_date, to_currency_code as TO_CRNCY, mid_value as MID_VAL, (case when inverse_quoted_flag = 'Y' THEN 1 else 0 end) AS inv_quoted_flg 
        from market.cppib_rates  mcr 
        join TENDAYS on TENDAYS.business_date = mcr.business_date
        where from_currency_code ='USD' and rate_type = 'SPOT' and  source_code = 'WM Company'
        union all 
		select business_date, 'USD' as TO_CRNCY, 1 as MID_VAL,0 as inv_quoted_flg from TENDAYS      
         )	 
      ),
T1_T2_Dates AS
(select date '2025-06-25' as T_1_Date,
  max(cast(business_date as date)) as T_2_Date
  from  holdings.enterprise_holding where cast(business_date as date) <  date '2025-06-25'
 )
SELECT  BUS_DTE,

        coalesce(sec_typ_nme,'') as sec_typ_nme,
        coalesce(sec_no,'')  as sec_no,
        coalesce(sec_nme,'') as sec_nme,
        coalesce(id_cppibsec,0) as id_cppibsec,
        coalesce(id_bb_ticker,'') as id_bb_ticker,
        coalesce(id_isin,'') as id_isin,
        coalesce(ID_BB_COMPANY,'0') as ID_BB_COMPANY,
		leg_no,
        coalesce(holding_level,'') as holding_level,
        coalesce(src_system_nme,'') as src_system_nme,
        coalesce(quoted_crncy,'') as quoted_crncy,
		coalesce(id_cusip,'') as id_cusip,
        cast(coalesce(T_1_BAL_NOMINAL,0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS T_1_BAL_NOMINAL,
        cast(coalesce(T_2_BAL_NOMINAL,0.0)as decimal(22,8)) AS T_2_BAL_NOMINAL,        
        cast(coalesce(T_1_LT_MKTVAL,0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS T_1_LT_MKTVAL,
        cast(coalesce(T_2_LT_MKTVAL,0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS T_2_LT_MKTVAL,
        cast(coalesce(T_1_CLEAN_PRC_QC,0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS T_1_CLEAN_PRC_QC,
        cast(coalesce(T_2_CLEAN_PRC_QC,0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS T_2_CLEAN_PRC_QC,
        cast(coalesce(T_1_CLEAN_PRC_UC,0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS T_1_CLEAN_PRC_UC, 
        cast(coalesce(T_2_CLEAN_PRC_UC,0.0)as decimal(22,8)) AS T_2_CLEAN_PRC_UC,
        cast(coalesce(T_1_FX_RTE_QC_PC,0.0)as decimal(22,8)) AS T_1_FX_RTE_QC_PC,
        cast(coalesce(T_2_FX_RTE_QC_PC,0.0)as decimal(22,8)) AS T_2_FX_RTE_QC_PC,
        cast(coalesce(T_1_FX_RTE_UC_QC,0.0) as decimal(22,8))AS T_1_FX_RTE_UC_QC,
        cast(coalesce(T_2_FX_RTE_UC_QC,0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS T_2_FX_RTE_UC_QC,
        cast(coalesce(CASE WHEN T_1_BAL_NOMINAL IS NULL AND T_2_BAL_NOMINAL IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(T_1_BAL_NOMINAL,0) - coalesce(T_2_BAL_NOMINAL,0)) END, 0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS BAL_NOMINAL_VARIANCE ,        
        cast(coalesce(CASE WHEN T_1_LT_MKTVAL IS NULL AND T_2_LT_MKTVAL  IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(T_1_LT_MKTVAL,0) - coalesce(T_2_LT_MKTVAL,0)) END, 0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS LT_MKTVAL_VARIANCE ,
        cast(coalesce(CASE WHEN T_1_CLEAN_PRC_QC IS NULL AND T_2_CLEAN_PRC_QC IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(T_1_CLEAN_PRC_QC,0) - coalesce(T_2_CLEAN_PRC_QC,0)) END, 0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS CLEAN_PRC_QC_VARIANCE ,
        cast(coalesce(CASE WHEN T_1_CLEAN_PRC_UC IS NULL AND T_2_CLEAN_PRC_UC IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(T_1_CLEAN_PRC_UC,0) - coalesce(T_2_CLEAN_PRC_UC,0)) END, 0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS CLEAN_PRC_UC_VARIANCE ,
        cast(coalesce(CASE WHEN T_1_FX_RTE_QC_PC IS NULL AND T_2_FX_RTE_QC_PC IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(T_1_FX_RTE_QC_PC,0) - coalesce(T_2_FX_RTE_QC_PC,0)) END, 0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS FX_RTE_QC_PC_VARIANCE ,
        cast(coalesce(CASE WHEN T_1_FX_RTE_UC_QC IS NULL AND T_2_FX_RTE_UC_QC IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (coalesce(T_1_FX_RTE_UC_QC,0) - coalesce(T_2_FX_RTE_UC_QC,0)) END, 0.0) as decimal(22,8)) AS FX_RTE_UC_QC_VARIANCE 
        FROM (          
              SELECT MAX(bus_dte) BUS_DTE,              
                     mpfc1_cde,
                     mpfc2_cde,
                     mport_cde,
                     instr_typ_nme,
                     sec_typ_nme,
                     sec_no,
                     sec_nme,
                     id_cppibsec,
                     id_bb_ticker,
                     id_isin, 
                     id_cusip, 
                     ID_BB_COMPANY,
                     leg_no,
                     holding_level,
                     src_system_nme,
                     quoted_crncy,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN xyz.balance_nominal ELSE 0 END) T_1_BAL_NOMINAL,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN xyz.balance_nominal ELSE 0 END) T_2_BAL_NOMINAL,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN xyz.total_market_value_pc ELSE 0 END) T_1_LT_MKTVAL,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN xyz.total_market_value_pc ELSE 0 END) T_2_LT_MKTVAL,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN (xyz.total_market_value_qc/xyz.balance_nominal) ELSE 0 END) T_1_CLEAN_PRC_QC,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN (xyz.total_market_value_qc/xyz.balance_nominal)  ELSE 0 END) T_2_CLEAN_PRC_QC,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN (xyz.total_market_value_qc/xyz.balance_nominal)* (1/FXRATE_UC_QC) ELSE 0 END) T_1_CLEAN_PRC_UC,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN (xyz.total_market_value_qc/xyz.balance_nominal)* (1/FXRATE_UC_QC) ELSE 0 END) T_2_CLEAN_PRC_UC ,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN xyz.FXRATE_QC_PC ELSE 0 END) T_1_FX_RTE_QC_PC,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN xyz.FXRATE_QC_PC ELSE 0 END) T_2_FX_RTE_QC_PC,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_1_Date THEN xyz.FXRATE_UC_QC ELSE 0 END) T_1_FX_RTE_UC_QC,                     
                     SUM(CASE WHEN xyz.bus_dte = T_2_Date THEN xyz.FXRATE_UC_QC ELSE 0 END) T_2_FX_RTE_UC_QC                    
				from	
					(SELECT mhl.business_date as bus_dte,              
                     eh.investment_department_responsibility_code as mpfc1_cde,
                     eh.investment_department_sub_group_responsibility_code as mpfc2_cde,
                     eh.model_portfolio_id as mport_cde,
                     eh.abor_instrument_type as instr_typ_nme,
                     eh.security_security_type_name as sec_typ_nme,
                     eh.abor_security_number as sec_no,
                     escundl.esm_security_name as sec_nme,
                     escundl.cppib_sec_id as id_cppibsec,
                     escundl.esm_ticker as id_bb_ticker,
                     escundl.isin as id_isin, 
                     escundl.cusip as id_cusip, 
                     escundl.bloomberg_id AS ID_BB_COMPANY,
                     mhl.leg_no,
                     mhl.holding_level,
                     escundl.esm_source_id as src_system_nme,
                     mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code as quoted_crncy,
                     CASE WHEN mhl.balance_nominal = 0 THEN NULL ELSE mhl.balance_nominal END as balance_nominal,                     
                     mhl.total_market_value_pc,                     
                     mhl.total_market_value_qc,
					 Round(CASE WHEN mhl.underlying_currency_code = mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code THEN 1.00 
								WHEN FXRATE_Quoted.inv_quoted_flg=1 AND FXRATE_Underlying.inv_quoted_flg=0 THEN (FXRATE_Underlying.MID_VAL * FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL) 
								WHEN FXRATE_Quoted.inv_quoted_flg=0 AND FXRATE_Underlying.inv_quoted_flg=1 THEN 1/(FXRATE_Underlying.MID_VAL * FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL) 
								WHEN FXRATE_Quoted.inv_quoted_flg=1 AND FXRATE_Underlying.inv_quoted_flg=1 THEN (FXRATE_Underlying.MID_VAL / FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL) 
								ELSE (FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL / FXRATE_Underlying.MID_VAL  )
							END,8) as FXRATE_UC_QC, 
					 Round(CASE  WHEN 'CAD' = mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code THEN 1.00 
								WHEN FXRATE_Quoted.inv_quoted_flg=1 AND FXRATE_Portfolio.inv_quoted_flg=0 THEN (FXRATE_Portfolio.MID_VAL * FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL ) 
								WHEN FXRATE_Quoted.inv_quoted_flg=0 AND FXRATE_Portfolio.inv_quoted_flg=1 THEN 1/ (FXRATE_Portfolio.MID_VAL * FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL  ) 
								WHEN FXRATE_Quoted.inv_quoted_flg=1 AND FXRATE_Portfolio.inv_quoted_flg=1 THEN (FXRATE_Portfolio.MID_VAL / FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL  ) 
								ELSE (FXRATE_Portfolio.MID_VAL / FXRATE_Quoted.MID_VAL )
							END,8) as FXRATE_QC_PC,
                     T1_T2_Dates.T_1_Date,
                     T1_T2_Dates.T_2_Date					 
					from holdings.enterprise_holding eh
                    join holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough_extended mhl on  mhl.business_Date  = eh.business_Date and eh.scd_holding_key_id = cast(mhl.parent_holding_key as varchar)
					join T1_T2_Dates T1_T2_Dates ON eh.business_date  = T1_T2_Dates.T_1_Date OR eh.business_date = T1_T2_Dates.T_2_Date
                    LEFT JOIN asset.enterprise_security escundl ON mhl.enterprise_security_id = escundl.enterprise_security_id and mhl.business_date = escundl.business_date --child
					left outer join FXRATE FXRATE_Quoted ON  FXRATE_Quoted.TO_CRNCY =  mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code and FXRATE_Quoted.business_date = mhl.business_date
				    left outer join FXRATE FXRATE_Underlying ON  FXRATE_Underlying.TO_CRNCY =  mhl.underlying_currency_code and FXRATE_Underlying.business_date = mhl.business_date   
                    left outer join FXRATE FXRATE_Portfolio ON  FXRATE_Portfolio.TO_CRNCY =  'CAD'  and FXRATE_Portfolio.business_date = mhl.business_date  
                    WHERE 1=1
                 and eh.portfolio_calculation_id = 'RISK METRICS_DAILY'
                and eh.portfolio_group_id = 'CPPIB GROUP'
                     AND ( 
							(upper(trim(eh.abor_security_type_id)) in ('FUT_BOND','CDS','TRSEQIC','TRSFIIC')    
								AND upper(mhl.holding_level) = 'LOOK THROUGH')
							OR
							((upper(trim(eh.abor_security_type_id))) in ('OP_OC_CR','IRS_IR','OP_OC_SW_P','OP_OC_SW_W')
								and upper(mhl.holding_level) = 'TOP LEVEL')
						) 
                    AND ( (  upper(trim(mhl.parent_security_type_name)) not LIKE '%INDEX%' 
                                  and mhl.leg_no < 2 
                                  AND upper(trim(eh.abor_security_type_id)) in ('FUT_BOND','TRSEQIC','TRSFIIC'))
                        OR ( mhl.leg_no = 2 AND upper(trim(eh.abor_security_type_id)) = 'CDS') )
					) xyz
                    GROUP BY 
					 mpfc1_cde,
                     mpfc2_cde,
                     mport_cde,
                     instr_typ_nme,
                     sec_typ_nme,
                     sec_no,
                     sec_nme,
                     id_cppibsec,
                     id_bb_ticker,
                     id_isin, 
                     id_cusip, 
                     ID_BB_COMPANY,
                     leg_no,
                     holding_level,
                     src_system_nme,
                     quoted_crncy
            )              
        WHERE
        1 = 1
        AND 
        (
          (T_1_BAL_NOMINAL IS NOT NULL OR T_2_BAL_NOMINAL IS NOT NULL) OR          
          (T_1_LT_MKTVAL IS NOT NULL OR T_2_LT_MKTVAL IS NOT NULL) OR
          (T_1_CLEAN_PRC_QC IS NOT NULL OR T_2_CLEAN_PRC_QC IS NOT NULL) OR
          (T_1_CLEAN_PRC_UC IS NOT NULL OR T_2_CLEAN_PRC_UC IS NOT NULL) OR
		  (T_1_FX_RTE_QC_PC IS NOT NULL OR T_2_FX_RTE_QC_PC IS NOT NULL) OR
          (T_1_FX_RTE_UC_QC IS NOT NULL OR T_2_FX_RTE_UC_QC IS NOT NULL))

WITH date_params AS (
SELECT DATE '2024-04-01' AS start_date, DATE '2025-06-30' AS end_date
)
select business_date,
adjusted_fx_currency,
sum(market_value_cad) market_value_cad,
sum(market_value_cad_t_1) market_value_cad_t_1,
sum(cash_flow_cad) cash_flow_cad,
round(sum(round(pnl_cad,2)),2) pnl_cad,
sum(round(pnl_currency_exposure_fx,2)) pnl_currency_exposure_fx,
sum(round(pnl_local_exposure_fx,2)) pnl_local_exposure_fx,
case when coalesce(round(sum(round(pnl_cad,2)),2)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0)=-1 then 0 else coalesce(round(sum(round(pnl_cad,2)),2)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0) end TWR_CAD,
case when coalesce(round(sum(round(pnl_local_exposure_fx,2)),2)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0)= -1 then 0 else coalesce(round(sum(round(pnl_local_exposure_fx,2)),2)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0) end TWR_Local_Exposure_FX,
(1+ case when coalesce(round(sum(round(pnl_cad,2)),2)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0)=-1 then 0 else coalesce(round(sum(round(pnl_cad,2)),2)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0) end)/(1+ case when coalesce(round(sum(round(pnl_local_exposure_fx,2)),2)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0)= -1 then 0 else coalesce(round(sum(round(pnl_local_exposure_fx,2)),2)/nullif(sum(market_value_cad_t_1),0),0) end ) -1 TWR_Currency_Adjusted_FX
from performance.pace_holding_pnl
cross join date_params
where performance_configuration_id in ('PC-POOLS')
and model_portfolio_code is not null
and component_type not in (
'Cash',
'Spot',
'Constituent from original',
'Constituent from spot',
'Constituent from generic decomposition',
'Residual from generic decomposition'
)
and cash_state not in ('Settled cash', 'Unsettled cash')
and business_date between date_params.start_date AND date_params.end_date
and adjusted_fx_currency = 'CNH'
group by business_date,adjusted_fx_currency
order by 1 limit 50000 -- {"user": "fzhao@cppib.com", "source": "pyxll"}

		)

	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM

	WHERE

		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY

		date_trunc('minute', datetime)

		AND hour between 05 and 06

		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-26 05:30:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500

	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

	smp.sst_custody_account_code,
	shm.model_portfolio_id,

	ss.abor_security_type_id,
	es.isin,
	cast(shm.business_date as date) as business_date,
	sp.portfolio_group_name,
	sp.portfolio_group_id,
	sp.portfolio_name,
	shm.portfolio_id,
	ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
	ss.abor_security_type_name,
	shm.quotation_currency_name,
	shm.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency,
	shm.clean_price clean_price_quotation_currency,
	shm.clean_value_quotation_currency,

	shm.clean_value_portfolio_currency,

	smp.model_portfolio_name,
	shm.balance_book_value_quotation_currency,
	shm.balance_book_value_portfolio_currency,
	shm.quotation_currency_code,
	shm.dirty_price,
	shm.dirty_value_total_quotation_currency,

	shm.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency,

	shm.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency,

left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.enterprise_security
) es
	on shm.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
	and es.rn = 1
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by cppib_sec_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.asset_security_identifiers
) asi
	on shm.cppib_sec_id = cast(asi.cppib_sec_id as varchar(50))
	and asi.rn = 1

	on smp.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
left join reference.scd_securities ss

	and shm.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number

	from reference.scd_portfolio

	on sp.latest = 1
	and shm.portfolio_id = sp.portfolio_id

	on spif.business_date = (select max(business_date) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = spif.model_portfolio
	and spif.investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'

	and es.esm_country_code = rcc_esm.country_code
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country
	on rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec
	on es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
	and coalesce(es.mic, 'null') = coalesce(rec.mic, 'null')
	and es.esm_exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
	and rec.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes)
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country
	on rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
	and rcc_trade_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
left join (

	row_number() over(partition by id_instrument order by business_date desc) latest
	from trades_deals.irs_trades

	on it.latest = 1
	and shm.abor_security_number = it.id_instrument) AS "holdings_base"

	smp.sst_custody_account_code,
	shm.model_portfolio_id,

	ss.abor_security_type_id,
	es.isin,
	cast(shm.business_date as date) as business_date,
	sp.portfolio_group_name,
	sp.portfolio_group_id,
	sp.portfolio_name,
	shm.portfolio_id,
	ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
	ss.abor_security_type_name,
	shm.quotation_currency_name,
	shm.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency,
	shm.clean_price clean_price_quotation_currency,
	shm.clean_value_quotation_currency,

	shm.clean_value_portfolio_currency,

	smp.model_portfolio_name,
	shm.balance_book_value_quotation_currency,
	shm.balance_book_value_portfolio_currency,
	shm.quotation_currency_code,
	shm.dirty_price,
	shm.dirty_value_total_quotation_currency,

	shm.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency,

	shm.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency,

left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.enterprise_security
) es
	on shm.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
	and es.rn = 1
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by cppib_sec_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.asset_security_identifiers
) asi
	on shm.cppib_sec_id = cast(asi.cppib_sec_id as varchar(50))
	and asi.rn = 1

	on smp.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
left join reference.scd_securities ss

	and shm.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number

	from reference.scd_portfolio

	on sp.latest = 1
	and shm.portfolio_id = sp.portfolio_id

	on spif.business_date = (select max(business_date) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = spif.model_portfolio
	and spif.investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'

	and es.esm_country_code = rcc_esm.country_code
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country
	on rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec
	on es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
	and coalesce(es.mic, 'null') = coalesce(rec.mic, 'null')
	and es.esm_exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
	and rec.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes)
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country
	on rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
	and rcc_trade_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
left join (

	row_number() over(partition by id_instrument order by business_date desc) latest
	from trades_deals.irs_trades

	on it.latest = 1
	and shm.abor_security_number = it.id_instrument) AS "holdings_base"

	smp.sst_custody_account_code,
	shm.model_portfolio_id,

	ss.abor_security_type_id,
	es.isin,
	cast(shm.business_date as date) as business_date,
	sp.portfolio_group_name,
	sp.portfolio_group_id,
	sp.portfolio_name,
	shm.portfolio_id,
	ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
	ss.abor_security_type_name,
	shm.quotation_currency_name,
	shm.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency,
	shm.clean_price clean_price_quotation_currency,
	shm.clean_value_quotation_currency,

	shm.clean_value_portfolio_currency,

	smp.model_portfolio_name,
	shm.balance_book_value_quotation_currency,
	shm.balance_book_value_portfolio_currency,
	shm.quotation_currency_code,
	shm.dirty_price,
	shm.dirty_value_total_quotation_currency,

	shm.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency,

	shm.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency,

left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.enterprise_security
) es
	on shm.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
	and es.rn = 1
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by cppib_sec_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.asset_security_identifiers
) asi
	on shm.cppib_sec_id = cast(asi.cppib_sec_id as varchar(50))
	and asi.rn = 1

	on smp.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
left join reference.scd_securities ss

	and shm.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number

	from reference.scd_portfolio

	on sp.latest = 1
	and shm.portfolio_id = sp.portfolio_id

	on spif.business_date = (select max(business_date) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = spif.model_portfolio
	and spif.investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'

	and es.esm_country_code = rcc_esm.country_code
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country
	on rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec
	on es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
	and coalesce(es.mic, 'null') = coalesce(rec.mic, 'null')
	and es.esm_exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
	and rec.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes)
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country
	on rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
	and rcc_trade_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
left join (

	row_number() over(partition by id_instrument order by business_date desc) latest
	from trades_deals.irs_trades

	on it.latest = 1
	and shm.abor_security_number = it.id_instrument) AS "holdings_base"

FROM (select

	shm.abor_security_id,
	es.sedol,

	asi.incorp_country_code, 
	smp.sst_custody_account_code,

	shm.balance_nominal_number,
	ss.abor_security_type_id,
	es.isin,
	cast(shm.business_date as date) as business_date,
	sp.portfolio_group_name,

	shm.clean_price * shm.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency clean_price_portfolio_currency,

	es.esm_country_code,
	rcc_esm.country_name as esm_country_name,
	es.esm_incorp_country_code,
	rcc_incorp_country.country_name as esm_incorp_country_name,
	rec.country_ref_code,
	rcc_trade_country.country_name as country_ref_name,
	smp.investment_strategy_name,
	smp.investment_department_name,
	spif.investmentstructurelevel3,
	spif.investmentstructurelevel4,
	smp.model_portfolio_name,

	shm.quotation_currency_code,
	shm.dirty_price,
	shm.dirty_value_total_quotation_currency,
	shm.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency,
	es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
	shm.abor_security_number,
	es.cppib_sec_id,
	ss_ul.abor_security_id as underlying_security_id,
	ss_ul.isin_id as underlying_isin,
	ss_ul.sedol_id as underlying_sedol,
	es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,
	es.esm_next_coupon_date,
	it.first_calculation_period_start_date,
	shm.balance_transaction_costs_quotation_currency,
	shm.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency,
	shm.balance_transaction_costs_portfolio_currency,
	shm.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency,
	shm.balance_expected_restitution_portfolio_currency,
	shm.accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency,
	shm.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency,
	shm.next_dividend_quotation_currency,
	shm.next_coupon_quotation_currency,
	shm.balance_nominal_number_unsettled,
		-- New issuer_country_code field
	case 
	    when shm.abor_security_type_id in ('FUT_EQT','FUT_BOND','FUT_IR', 'FUT_COMDTY') then es.esm_country_code
	    when shm.abor_security_type_id = 'CDS' then null
	    else ss.abor_country_id 
	end as issuer_country_code
from holdings.scd_holdings_main shm
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.enterprise_security
) es
	on shm.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
	and es.rn = 1
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by cppib_sec_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.asset_security_identifiers
) asi
	on shm.cppib_sec_id = cast(asi.cppib_sec_id as varchar(50))
	and asi.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio smp
	on smp.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
left join reference.scd_securities ss
	on ss.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_securities)
	and shm.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
left join (
	select *, 
	row_number() over(partition by portfolio_id order by business_date desc) latest
	from reference.scd_portfolio
) sp
	on sp.latest = 1
	and shm.portfolio_id = sp.portfolio_id
left join performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten spif
	on spif.business_date = (select max(business_date) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = spif.model_portfolio
	and spif.investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc
	on rcc.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and asi.incorp_country_code = rcc.country_code
left join reference.scd_securities ss_ul
	on cast(ss_ul.scd_security_key_id as varchar) = es.esm_underlying_instrument_id 
	and cast(ss_ul.business_date as date) = es.business_date
	and es.enterprise_security_source = 'SCD'
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_esm
	on rcc_esm.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and es.esm_country_code = rcc_esm.country_code
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country
	on rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec
	on es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
	and coalesce(es.mic, 'null') = coalesce(rec.mic, 'null')
	and es.esm_exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
	and rec.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes)
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country
	on rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
	and rcc_trade_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
left join (
	select *, 
	row_number() over(partition by id_instrument order by business_date desc) latest
	from trades_deals.irs_trades
) it
	on it.latest = 1
	and shm.abor_security_number = it.id_instrument) AS "holdings_base"

SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1

/* cppi::55d41945b69b83f075f858e7cfc83a5a1282e05e5728cfb9ad1c0e8d8b431aff */
/* QuickSight 2612de4e-5921-46c1-82b9-11ad61a374a7 */
SELECT "business_date", "pool_name", "account_name", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "external_reporting_dm_em", "external_reporting_region", "external_reporting_country", "external_reporting_assetmix", "business_date_string", "year_month", "is_month_end", "is_fiscalyear_end", "external_reporting_dm_em_region", "external_reporting_currency", "total_market_value_pc"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-14')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-14')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_start                         AS "Total Market Value PC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl

/* cppi::75752a5d961f7395d461a5dd32c46d54053fd6a401cd912cee47e9abb03430ea */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 26
		AND hour between 05 and 06
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-26 05:38:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc

	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date

			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from

-- Query # 2 of 3 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code

    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date

-- Query # 2 of 3 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code

    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i

-- Query # 2 of 3 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code

/* QuickSight 30252e6c-44e4-43fe-b59f-5d3b383281e4 */
SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency

		, case

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
